resumeText:
SARAH MITCHELL
Brisbane, QLD | 0400 123 456 | sarah.mitchell@example.com | linkedin.com/in/sarahmitchell-dev
Australian Citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Passionate, hard-working team player with a strong desire to learn and grow. Dedicated and enthusiastic individual who is always eager to take on new challenges and deliver great results.

SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, Git, REST APIs, Jest

EXPERIENCE

Mathematics Teacher - Riverside State High School, Brisbane
03/2017 - 12/2023
Taught mathematics to students in Years 8 to 12, covering topics from basic algebra to calculus and statistics, and prepared students for the Queensland Certificate of Education.
- Developed and delivered lesson plans for five different year levels each semester, adapting content to a wide range of learning styles.
- Coordinated the school's annual Mathematics Careers Day, inviting guest speakers from engineering and finance industries to talk to students about pathways after school.
- Ran the after-school Chess Club for three years, organising inter-school tournaments and managing a roster of 20 student members.
- Supervised school camps to Stradbroke Island and the Sunshine Coast, managing student welfare, transport logistics and emergency procedures for groups of up to 60 students.
- Sat on the school's Pastoral Care committee, contributing to policy discussions around student wellbeing and attendance.
- Mentored two graduate teachers in their first year, providing informal guidance on classroom management and marking rubrics.
- Managed communication with over 100 parents each semester regarding student progress, attending parent-teacher evenings twice a year.
- Organised the Year 12 formal for three consecutive years, coordinating venues, catering and student committees.

Retail Assistant - Northside Sports, Brisbane
01/2015 - 02/2017
Worked part-time on weekends while completing teaching qualification, assisting customers and managing stock on the shop floor.
- Handled point-of-sale transactions and stock replenishment during busy weekend trading periods.
- Trained two new casual staff members on store procedures and customer service standards.

Junior Full-Stack Developer (Bootcamp Capstone Project) - Self-directed, Brisbane
01/2024 - 06/2024
Completed an intensive full-stack web development bootcamp after leaving teaching, building three applications from scratch to transition into software development.
- Built a full-stack task management app using React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL, reducing the number of clicks needed to create a task from 5 to 2 through UI redesign.
- Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control, supporting 3 distinct user roles.
- Wrote 45 unit and integration tests with Jest, achieving 82% code coverage on the backend API.
- Deployed the application to Render and Vercel, configuring CI so that pushes to main automatically ran the test suite and deployed on success.
GitHub: github.com/sarahmitchell-dev/task-tracker | Live demo: task-tracker-demo.vercel.app

PROJECTS

Budget Buddy - Personal Finance Tracker
Built a personal finance tracking app with React and a Node/Express/PostgreSQL backend, allowing users to categorise transactions and view monthly spending charts.
- Designed a recurring transaction feature that cut manual data entry by an estimated 70% for repeat bills.
- Used TypeScript across frontend and backend to catch type errors during development, reducing runtime bugs reported in testing from 12 to 2.
GitHub: github.com/sarahmitchell-dev/budget-buddy | Live demo: budget-buddy-demo.netlify.app

Classroom Roster API
A REST API built with Node.js and Express to manage student rosters and grades, inspired by tools used in my teaching career.
- Modelled database schema in PostgreSQL across 6 related tables and wrote raw SQL queries for common reporting needs.
- Documented all endpoints with example requests, enabling a fellow bootcamp student to integrate a frontend against it in under a day.
GitHub: github.com/sarahmitchell-dev/classroom-roster-api

EDUCATION

Diploma in Full-Stack Web Development
Brisbane Coding Academy, Brisbane - 01/2024 - 06/2024

Bachelor of Education (Secondary) - Mathematics
University of Queensland, Brisbane - 02/2011 - 11/2014

REFEREES
Available on request
